scenes.text: Round a decimal by inspecting the digit just to the right of the last wanted place.
Round 0.370 to 2 decimal place(s). The answer is 0.37. Look at the next decimal digit and round to 0.37.
A measured length at a science exhibition is 0.717 metres. Round it to two decimal place(s). Pause the video and think.
